episodes.synopsis: Cyberphysician Daisuke Ido comes across the remains of a female cyborg, who is still alive. Ido takes her home and restores her, transferring her into a new cyborg body.
episodes.title: Rusty Angel

episodes.synopsis: As Yugo and Tanji prepare to leave an alley with their cyborg victim's spinal column, Vector appears and kills the cyborg to eliminate him as a witness, then admonishes Yugo for his carelessness.
episodes.title: Tears Sign
